tool.name: mumemto find
tool.description: Find maximal unique matches (multi-MUMs) and maximal exact matches (multi-MEMs) across pangenomes
tool.command: ## Symlink input FASTA files with .fa extension so mumemto recognizes them #for $i, $fasta in enumerate($input_fastas): ln -s '$fasta' input${i}.fa && #end for mumemto -o 'output' #if $options.min_sequences: -k $options.min_sequences #end if -f $options.max_per_sequence #if $options.max_total: -F $options.max_total #end if $options.binary_output #if $options.merge_mode == 'string': -M #elif $options.merge_mode == 'anchor': -Mn #end if #if $options.min_match_len: -l $options.min_match_len #end if #if $options.window: -w $options.window #end if #if $options.modulus: -m $options.modulus #end if #if $options.no_revcomp: -r #end if #for $i in range(len($input_fastas)): input${i}.fa #end for && ## Rename outputs to Galaxy-expected names #if $options.binary_output: mv 'output.bumbl' '$mums_output' #elif $options.max_per_sequence > 1: mv 'output.mems' '$mums_output' #else: mv 'output.mums' '$mums_output' #end if && mv 'output.lengths' '$lengths_output' #if $options.merge_mode == 'string': && mv 'output.thresh' '$thresh_output' && mv 'output.thresh_rev' '$thresh_rev_output' #end if #if $options.merge_mode == 'anchor': && mv 'output.athresh' '$athresh_output' #end if

param.name: input_fastas
param.label: Input FASTA file(s)
param.help: One or more FASTA files (one per genome/assembly)

param.name: min_sequences
param.label: Minimum number of sequences a match must occur in
param.help: Positive = absolute number; negative = relative to N (e.g., -1 = all but one sequence)

param.name: max_per_sequence
param.label: Maximum occurrences per sequence
param.help: 1 = strict multi-MUMs (default); values > 1 find multi-MEMs (e.g., duplicated regions)

param.name: max_total
param.label: Maximum total occurrences in collection
param.help: Negative values are relative to N

param.name: merge_mode
param.label: Merging mode
param.help: String-based merging (-M) generates .thresh and .thresh_rev files; anchor-based merging (-Mn) generates .athresh files. Use these with mumemto merge to combine partitioned runs.

param.name: no_revcomp
param.label: Disable reverse complement search
param.help: By default, the reverse complement of sequences is included. Check to exclude.

tool.help:
# mumemto find
**What it does**
Mumemto finds maximal unique matches (multi-MUMs) and maximal exact matches (multi-MEMs) across a collection of pangenome sequences. It uses the prefix-free parse (PFP) algorithm for efficient suffix array construction on large, repetitive text collections.
## Finding multi-MUMs/MEMs
Provide one or more FASTA files (one per genome/assembly). By default, strict multi-MUMs are computed (match appears exactly once in every sequence).
## Parameters
- **Min sequences (-k):** Minimum number of sequences a match must occur in. Negative values are relative to N (e.g., -1 = all but one). - **Max per sequence (-f):** Maximum occurrences per sequence. Default 1 (MUMs). Values > 1 find multi-MEMs (e.g., duplicated regions). - **Max total (-F):** Maximum total occurrences in the collection. Useful for filtering low-complexity matches. Negative values are relative to N. - **Binary output (-b):** Output binary `.bumbl` format instead of text. - **Min match length (-l):** Minimum MUM or MEM length (default: 20). - **Merging mode:** Enable string-based (`-M`) or anchor-based (`-Mn`) merging to generate threshold files for downstream partition merging with mumemto merge. - **No reverse complement (-r):** Exclude the reverse complement of sequences. - **Window size (-w):** Window size used for PFP (default: 10). - **Hash modulus (-m):** Hash modulus used for PFP (default: 100).
## Output formats
- `.mums` — multi-MUM output (when `-f 1`): one line per MUM with length, comma-delimited offsets, and strand indicators. - `.mems` — multi-MEM output (when `-f > 1`): one line per MEM with length, offsets, sequence IDs, and strand indicators. - `.bumbl` — binary format for faster I/O (use `-b` flag). - `.lengths` — sequence lengths and filelist. - `.thresh` / `.thresh_rev` — threshold files (with string-based merging). - `.athresh` — anchor threshold files (with anchor-based merging).
## Visualization
Use the **mumemto viz** tool to generate synteny plots from `.mums` output.
## Merging
Use the **mumemto merge** tool to combine multi-MUMs from partitioned runs.
For detailed usage, see the [Mumemto wiki](https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki).
